questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (e.g., 00:09), there are exactly three pens arranged on it.
All three pens have their caps (black end) pointing downwards. Although the rightmost pen is slightly angled, it is not flipped 180 degrees relative to the others.
All three pens appear to be the same dark color (black/dark grey barrels and caps).
All three pens appear complete with caps on the bottom end; none show an exposed tip or look significantly shorter.
The board moves smoothly and continuously from the left side of the frame to the right side without stopping or reversing.

parsed.reason: The video shows a board with three identical pens moving smoothly from left to right. All pens are capped, same color, and oriented with caps down, satisfying all nominal conditions.

description: One pen is flipped relative to the others (variant).
